title: Fulbright Programme
summary: The Fulbright programme finances academic stays in Germany for US citizens, including graduates, teaching assistants, post-doctoral students, lecturers, and researchers through various funding opportunities.

degree_levels.notes: Open to graduates, lecturers, researchers, and teaching assistants or teacher-training students.

subject_areas.notes: Generally open to almost any academic discipline.

residence.notes: Aimed at US citizens living in and applying from the United States of America.

mandatory.text: interest in and commitment to the US-German cultural exchange

funding.description: Funding modalities and grant amount depend on the individual sponsorship programme. Options include full-time sponsorship, travel grants, monthly stipend, health insurance, travel allowance, living costs, and other benefits depending on the grant type.
funding.duration: depending on the type of stipend (please see formal requirements)

application_rounds.notes: Application deadlines differ depending on the selected grant programme.

steps.text: Please see all application forms and further information on the application procedure on the Fulbright website.

sources.title: Fulbright Commission: Fulbright Programme - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme finances academic stays by US citizens in Germany, including graduates and researchers, for physical study or research in Germany.
